name: io.github.pact-community-organization/devnet
description: Devnet lifecycle management: gated docker compose up/down/reset plus read-only status, health, and log tools for local Chainweb devnets.

environmentVariables.name: PACT_COMMUNITY_DEVNET_ALLOW_LIFECYCLE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable devnet.up/devnet.down (default false).

environmentVariables.name: PACT_COMMUNITY_DEVNET_ALLOW_VOLUME_WIPE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable volume-wiping operations (default false).
